messages:
incident-bot: AUTOPAGE -> PagerDuty PDX-8234 triggered for host gpu-rt17-45 :rotating_light:
incident-bot: symptom=kernel oops -> kubelet NotReady, severity=high, region=prod-us-west, link=<pd://PDX-8234>

maya: ack - I'm on it. pinging serial and trying SSH.

pagerduty: Alert acknowledged by maya (oncall).

maya: quick check: `kubectl get nodes | grep gpu-rt17-45`
```
# kubectl output
gpu-rt17-45   NotReady   28m   v1.27.3   10.12.17.45   <none>
```

kai: if kubelet is dead we should cordon and drain asap. any customer traffic hitting that host?

olivia: routing/edge shows a short spike of 5xxs routed from rack-7. impact estimate: ~0.5% requests over last 1m, a few PLG trial users saw failures. no major enterprise tenants affected per quick lookup.

maya: SSH fails, serial console attach also times out. tried `screen /dev/serial/by-id/xyz` -> no output. requested serial logs dump from BMC:
```
[ 1234.567890] kernel: nvme: controller 0000:5e:00.0: abort status: 0xdeadbeef
[ 1234.567892] kernel: nvme0: pci error: two consecutive fatal errors
[ 1234.567895] kernel: kernel panic - not syncing: NULL pointer deref in nvme_core
[ 1234.567900] Kernel panic - starting dump
```

tony: I'm on pager, will join for escalation. if NVMe triggered kernel oops, HW Ops / RMA is likely. but first get workloads off the host. maya, cordon?

maya: running `kubectl cordon gpu-rt17-45` then drain (ignore daemonsets, delete local data).
```
$ kubectl cordon gpu-rt17-45
node/gpu-rt17-45 cordoned
$ kubectl drain gpu-rt17-45 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
evicting pod/train-worker-1
evicting pod/redis-cache-local (force delete local data)
pods evicted, waiting for reschedule...
```

deploy-bot: Autoscaler noticed pressure and spun up replacement node(s) in pool gpu-dedicated-rt17 to maintain capacity.

kai: checking pod reschedules - most workloads rescheduled nicely, a couple of batch jobs restarted, nothing persistent lost. can we check PV mounts for local-storage pods?

olivia: PV audit: two ephemeral local pods lost local scratch, jobs resumed from checkpoint storage. no durable PVs on that host.

maya: creating incident doc: https://internal/incidents/PDX-8234 with initial timeline, actions, and logs. tagging with "kernel-oops" "nvme" "kubelet-notready".

pagerduty: Escalation: tony (sre-lead) notified.

tony: ack. assigning RMA to hw-ops oncall and opening hardware ticket. I'll attach serial logs and kernel oops to the ticket. please add any additional logs to the incident doc.

maya: summary/handoff (leaving thread): root symptom: NVMe-related kernel oops caused kubelet to die; node became NotReady and inaccessible via SSH/serial. mitigation: cordoned & drained, autoscaler replaced capacity, minor customer-facing 5xx spike ~0.5% short window, no persistent data loss. followups: HW RMA, kernel oops triage, add regression test for nvme driver on kernel X.Y.Z.

maya: marking "oncall done" in PD - leaving incident open for RMA and postmortem.

tony: noted. I'll own postmortem and liaise with HW. thanks team. :thumbsup:
